title: Hobi Hobi no Mi
structure: 3 techniques + the ageless side effect as the peak (the fruit has no stages and no awakening shown)
facts: Appearance (One Piece Wiki via search): a wheel-shaped fruit with a light yellow, spiraling core at both of its sides and a red, swirly outer shell that envelops its meridian; green stem (secondary source)
Paramecia, English name Hobby-Hobby Fruit: turns living people into toys with a touch
Everyone forgets the people turned into toys ever existed (Kyros and Rebecca)
Toys are made to sign a contract and must obey the user's orders
Side effect: the user's body stops aging (eternal youth)
If the user is knocked out, all toys return to normal and the memories come back (Dressrosa)
Sugar, Trebol Army special officer of the Donquixote Pirates; she fainted after Usopp's terrifying face
